audio.text: I'm not sure the payment plan is worth the extra fee.

options: The fee for the gym is twenty dollars a term for students.
I'm sure I paid for our lunch yesterday.
It might be, if it saves you from taking out a loan.
Plans for the new library were approved.

why.en: Doubt → a reasoned reply. A repeats "fee" about the gym; B repeats "sure" and "paid"; D repeats "plan" with another meaning.
why.tr: Şüphe → gerekçeli bir cevap. A "fee" kelimesini spor salonu için tekrar ediyor; B "sure" ve "paid" kelimelerini tekrar ediyor; D "plan" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
why.es: Duda → una respuesta razonada. A repite "fee" sobre el gimnasio; B repite "sure" y "paid"; D usa "plan" con otro sentido.
